about: Route files another app wrote, read by the engine's route_file_read before the pilot uses one: a Garmin FlightPlan v1 .fpl (http://www8.garmin.com/xmlschemas/FlightPlan/v1), as Garmin Pilot and ForeFlight export it, and a GPX 1.1 route. Field places from NASR APT_BASE (KMSN, KOSH, C81, KJVL) and NAV_BASE (MSN); the user points made up. Read by engine/facade/tests/route_file.rs and the web's features/shared-flight/routeFile.test.ts.

cases.name: a Garmin .fpl: an airport, a VOR, a user waypoint, an airport
cases.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<flight-plan xmlns="http://www8.garmin.com/xmlschemas/FlightPlan/v1">
  <created>20261121T12:00:00Z</created>
  <waypoint-table>
    <waypoint><identifier>KMSN</identifier><type>AIRPORT</type><country-code>K5</country-code><lat>43.139858</lat><lon>-89.337514</lon><comment>DANE CO RGNL/TRUAX FLD</comment></waypoint>
    <waypoint><identifier>MSN</identifier><type>VOR</type><country-code>K5</country-code><lat>43.144772</lat><lon>-89.338661</lon><comment>MADISON</comment></waypoint>
    <waypoint><identifier>USR001</identifier><type>USER WAYPOINT</type><country-code /><lat>43.5</lat><lon>-88.9</lon><comment /></waypoint>
    <waypoint><identifier>KOSH</identifier><type>AIRPORT</type><country-code>K5</country-code><lat>43.984389</lat><lon>-88.556972</lon><comment>WITTMAN RGNL</comment></waypoint>
  </waypoint-table>
  <route>
    <route-name>KMSN TO KOSH</route-name>
    <flight-plan-index>1</flight-plan-index>
    <route-point><waypoint-identifier>KMSN</waypoint-identifier><waypoint-type>AIRPORT</waypoint-type><waypoint-country-code>K5</waypoint-country-code></route-point>
    <route-point><waypoint-identifier>MSN</waypoint-identifier><waypoint-type>VOR</waypoint-type><waypoint-country-code>K5</waypoint-country-code></route-point>
    <route-point><waypoint-identifier>USR001</waypoint-identifier><waypoint-type>USER WAYPOINT</waypoint-type><waypoint-country-code /></route-point>
    <route-point><waypoint-identifier>KOSH</waypoint-identifier><waypoint-type>AIRPORT</waypoint-type><waypoint-country-code>K5</waypoint-country-code></route-point>
  </route>
</flight-plan>
